name: Rivaroxaban
class: Direct oral anticoagulant – factor Xa inhibitor
status: DRAFT – pharmacology (†) is not yet checked against the package insert; doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text
dagger_note: † = general pharmacology; not in the SA guideline and not yet checked against the package insert
item_format: t=text, s=source:printed page, d=dagger, b=bold, h=heading

moa.t: Directly and reversibly inhibits factor Xa

dosing_note: Doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text. Each heading is the nearest section title in the guideline and can be off by one section – confirm on the cited page. The pathway dose stays authoritative for its indication.

items.t: Rivaroxaban, oral, 10 mg daily while hospitalised.
Rivaroxaban, oral, 10 mg daily. · Initated 6–10 hours post-surgery for duration of admission or a maximum of 10 days.
Rivaroxaban, oral, 10 mg daily. · Initiate anticoagulation 6–10 hours post-surgery for the duration of hospital admission for a minimum of 2 days and a maximum of 7 days.
Rivaroxaban, oral, 15 mg twice daily for 3 weeks, followed by 20 mg once daily for 3 months.

cautions.t: Levels lowered by rifampicin, carbamazepine and phenytoin, and raised by azoles and protease inhibitors

monitoring.t: Renal function, no routine coagulation monitoring
